دَرَّاجٌ One who creeps along (يَدْرُجُ) with calumny, or slander, among people: (A:) one who calumniates, or slanders, much or frequently. (Lh, K.) ―
-b2- الدَّرَّاجُ The hedge-hog; syn. القُنْفُذُ: (K:) because he creeps along all the night: an epithet in which the quality of a subst. predominates. (TA.) ―
-b3- أَبُو دَرَّاجٍ A certain small bird. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
